fields.description: When ticked, a daily job creates annual leave allocations for employees who reach their 1-year mark. Turn on only after the leave Sheet import is reconciled.
fields.label: Allocate Annual Leave Automatically

fields.description: Leave Type used for annual leave. It must allow over allocation and must not be earned or carry-forward leave.
fields.label: Annual Leave Type

fields.description: Days of annual leave in every leave period after the one in which the 1-year mark falls.
fields.label: Annual Days After the First Year

fields.description: Days of annual leave in the leave period of the 1-year mark, by the quarter the mark falls in. The 1-year mark is the join date plus 12 months.
fields.label: Annual Leave in the Year of the 1-Year Mark
Allocate Casual Leave Automatically
fields.description: When ticked, the daily job creates casual leave allocations and adds the extra day at the 1-year mark. Turn on only after the leave Sheet import is reconciled.

fields.label: Casual Leave Type
fields.description: Leave Type used for casual leave. It must not be earned or carry-forward leave.

fields.label: Casual Days per Month in the Joining Year
fields.description: Granted up front for each month from the join month to December, counting the join month.

fields.label: Casual Days Before the 1-Year Mark
fields.description: Days in a leave period after the joining year, until the 1-year mark.

fields.label: Casual Days From the 1-Year Mark
fields.description: Days in a leave period once the 1-year mark is reached; in the year of the mark the difference is added on the mark date.

fields.label: Allocate Additional Leave Automatically
fields.description: When ticked, the daily job creates additional leave allocations before the 1-year mark. Turn on only after the leave Sheet import is reconciled.

fields.label: Additional Leave Type
fields.description: Leave Type used for additional leave. It must not be earned or carry-forward leave.

fields.label: Additional Days Before the 1-Year Mark
fields.description: Days in each leave period before the 1-year mark, usable until the day before the mark.

fields.label: Allocate Medical Leave Automatically
fields.description: When ticked, the daily job creates medical leave allocations from joining. Turn on only after the leave Sheet import is reconciled.

fields.label: Medical Leave Type
fields.description: Leave Type used for medical leave. It must allow over allocation, because a December joiner receives more days than remain in the period, and must not be earned or carry-forward leave.

fields.label: Medical Days per Leave Period
fields.description: Days in every leave period from joining, in full in the joining year.
